problem_statement: Validating a MAC frame PSDU that uses an unsupported frame type (Multipurpose or Reserved) or an unsupported frame version does not detect the malformed header: the frame is reported as valid. A PSDU whose Frame Control Field encodes a non-standard frame type (e.g. Multipurpose, value 5, or Reserved, value 4) or a future/unsupported frame version (e.g. 3) must be rejected as a parse error, while standard Data/Beacon/Ack/MAC-Command frames of supported versions (2003/2006/2015) must still validate successfully.
